{"step":2,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"php_mb_regex_split","line":null,"var":"pattern","code":"mb_split forwards the anchor pattern to the mbregex engine and iterates over matches in the subject.","note":"The empty-match regex is compiled and then repeatedly executed against the attacker-controlled subject string."},
{"step":3,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_ANCHOR","code":"case NODE_ANCHOR: r = tune_anchor(node, reg, state, env);","note":"The compiled AST contains an anchor-only branch, which is significant because it can match zero-width positions repeatedly."},
{"step":4,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_tree","line":5518,"var":"NODE_QUANT","code":"case NODE_QUANT: r = tune_quant(node, reg, state, env);","note":"Quantifier handling still runs during compilation, and the empty-match classification feeds later repeated execution behavior."},
{"step":5,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5458,"var":"qn->emptiness","code":"qn->emptiness = quantifiers_memory_node_info(body);","note":"The compiler tags the quantified body as possibly empty or memory-bearing, the key state used in the crash report."},
{"step":6,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"quantifiers_memory_node_info","line":4894,"var":"node","code":"quantifiers_memory_node_info(Node* node)","note":"The recursive classifier processes the AST structure from the attacker input and propagates the empty-match state."},
{"step":7,"file":"ext/mbstring/php_mbregex.c","function":"mb_split execution loop","line":null,"var":"search position","code":"mb_split repeatedly advances through matches while tracking the current position in the subject.","note":"Because the pattern can match the empty string at every line start, execution keeps revisiting the same logical region and stresses the stale state introduced by compilation."},
{"step":8,"file":"oniguruma/src/regcomp.c","function":"tune_quant","line":5470,"var":"compiled regex","code":"r = tune_tree(body, reg, state, env);","note":"The finalized regex state is then consumed by the split loop, which is expected to expose the heap-use-after-free read at runtime."}
]
